evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic maxim that renders a technical reliability claim in plain, memorable opposition — the document's register signature crystallized in one line.
Flat directive cadence — no hedges, no intensifiers, instrumental phrasing that sets the document's plain baseline.

mints.name: RuleAsMatchedOpposition
mints.title: crystallize a rule into matched opposed clauses
mints.frame: Does the expression cast an operational rule as a symmetric antithesis — the same noun on both sides, negated — to make it memorable?
